title: Politics explained

faq.a: MSME stands for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises. These are small businesses classified based on their investment in plant and machinery or equipment, and their annual turnover. They play a vital role in India's economy by creating jobs and contributing to production.

faq.q: Which types of businesses will benefit most from this policy?
faq.a: Businesses in Haryana that are involved in manufacturing and exporting goods are likely to benefit most, especially those looking to expand their international presence. The policy also supports small traders through expanded insurance.

faq.q: When will this policy officially start?
faq.a: The "Progressive MSME and Export Promotion Policy 2026" is currently in its draft stage and awaiting cabinet approval from the Haryana government. Once approved, it will be officially launched.

faq.q: How can an MSME apply for these benefits?
faq.a: Specific details on the application process for subsidies, incentives, and portal registration will be released once the policy is officially unveiled. It is expected to involve applications through relevant government departments or dedicated online portals.

faq.q: Is this policy only for new businesses?
faq.a: No, the policy aims to support both existing MSMEs looking to grow and new entrepreneurs setting up businesses in Haryana. Measures like the SAKSHAM fund for industrial area rejuvenation and the land-on-lease policy can benefit both established and new ventures.
